narrative.details:
This is the last of the items, and I won't lie, it ain't pretty. I'm also expecting this to take you a little bit longer than the other items.

So, enough with the warning, let's get this started. Leftwitch says he needs: ten brains from either mana eaters, mage hunters, or ley hunters. Ten nether wings from a nether maiden, sister or sorceress. And... ten vials of doomwarder blood from a doomwarder captain, or lord.

Simple enough, huh? Sheesh... if you wanna pass on this one, I'd understand.
narrative.objectives: Bring 10 Felhound Brains, 10 Nether Wings, and 10 vials of Doomwarder Blood to Kreldig Ungor in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Honestly? I wouldn't have thought it. You're amazing, adventurer. Taking on demons for a mage's experiments, and coming back in one piece to boot. Great job!

I'm personally gonna tell Roetten about you when I get back to Ironforge.
narrative.requestItemsText:
I didn't even realize these demon things were in Desolace. Last I read, centaur pretty much owned the land after the night elves picked up and left years ago.

I wonder why they took up here, and how.
